_source.status: No published source. LTA's GTFS feed omits the standard transfers.txt (which would carry min_transfer_time), and neither DataMall nor data.gov.sg publishes platform-to-platform walking times.
_source.default: Every interchange therefore uses one assumed figure until someone measures it. The figure is deliberately a single number rather than 40 invented ones: a per-station guess would look like data without being any.
_source.howToImprove: Time the walk between platforms, then add an entry to `overrides` with source and confidence. Surveyed values replace the default for that pair only.

default.note: A round figure covering a typical cross-platform or one-level change. Long interchanges such as Dhoby Ghaut or Outram Park take considerably more; short ones such as Tanah Merah take less.
